description: An example mod to copy: one KiCad board with its BOM and schematic, and the same board as a repair challenge.

boards.title: Night light (sandbox)
boards.description: A two-AA night light: push SW1 and D1 lights. The KiCad file has no resistor values; the BOM sets R1 to 68 Ω and leaves R2 unfitted. Probe it, then plant your own faults in the Author tab.
